title: Restaurant Direct tenant infrastructure
description: Server-side settings for one restaurant. Kept out of the site config so none of it ships in the browser bundle. Generate the SQL with npm run tenant:sql -- <slug>.

supabaseProjectRef.description: The project ref from the Supabase dashboard URL, or PLACEHOLDER until created.

vercelProject.description: The Vercel project name for the restaurant's live site.

phoneCountryCode.description: Digits only, e.g. 27. Used to match 082... and +27 82... as the same guest.

webhooks.description: n8n webhook URLs. null switches that notification off; it is logged as skipped, never an error.

localTime.description: Restaurant-local time the daily review emails go out, or null for none.
